This plot is small, only a corner near the house, so I manage it mostly with what I already have at home. I went to school some years but I still farm the way my father showed me for this kind of plot — I put the manure from our cattle here because it is close, and I do not waste the fertilizer from the cooperative on such a small piece when my bigger plots need it more. I use the planting material I kept from last season because it did well and I trust it. My wife and I do all the work ourselves; the plot is too small to pay anyone.

My reasoning: one bag of DAP is 50 kg and costs too much money for 0.14 ha — it would be thrown away on this piece. Manure I have for free from the compound. No pump, no river nearby, so I wait for the rains like everyone in my village. Pests I watch with my eyes and pull by hand; I do not buy chemicals for this plot.
